dataflowSinks.name: UserQueryoutputpq
dataflowSinks.script:
sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	input(
		circuitId as string,
		circuitRef as string,
		name as string,
		location as string,
		country as string,
		lat as string,
		lng as string,
		alt as string,
		url as string
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> UserQueryoutputpq
